candidate_rationale: GH17 glycoside hydrolase with X8/CBM43 module. Barley's own (1,3;1,4)-beta-glucan endohydrolases EI/EII (HvGlb1, HvGlb2) are GH17 enzymes, so this is the enzyme family that degrades mixed-linkage glucan, the main soluble fibre of the grain. Caveat: step-09 maps HvGlb1 to 1H 396 Mb and HvGlb2 to 7H 624 Mb, so this is an uncharacterised GH17 paralog, not either known endohydrolase; many GH17s are callose (1,3)-glucanases.

Plastidic anion/phosphate transporter, PHT4 family (MFS PF07690; GO:0005315 inorganic phosphate transmembrane transporter, GO:0009536 plastid). Pi is the allosteric brake on AGPase, so Pi flux across the plastid envelope sets the rate of starch synthesis; in Arabidopsis, loss of PHT4;2 alters starch accumulation by this route. PARALOG CAVEAT: the Swiss-Prot hit is Q8W0H5 rice PHT4;3 (84.2% id, 99.8% cov) and the GFF projects from AT3G46980 = Arabidopsis PHT4;3, whereas the starch phenotype is documented for PHT4;2 (AT2G38060) - so the mechanism is a family-level inference, not established for this paralog, and PHT4 substrates are not uniform (PHT4;4 is an ascorbate transporter). Defensible claim: a plastid-localised anion/phosphate transporter at a starch locus. Also the one gene of the original curated four (PHT) that survived the FLANK_BP=0 tightening.

GPAT6-type bifunctional glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase/phosphatase producing sn-2 monoacylglycerol, the committed step of cutin biosynthesis (GO:0010143 cutin biosynthetic process). Cutin and suberin of the pericarp/testa are recovered in the insoluble-fibre fraction, and tomato GPAT6 is documented to alter epidermal cell-wall properties.

SANT/Myb DNA-binding domain (PF00249). R2R3-MYBs are the master transcriptional regulators of secondary cell wall biosynthesis (cellulose, xylan, lignin), so the family is a strong prior for a fibre locus. Weak on specificity: Swiss-Prot query coverage is only 33%, so this is a domain-level call, and MYB is a very large family with many unrelated roles.

WUSCHEL-related homeobox 9 (WOX9/STIMPY), homeodomain PF00046, 82.9% identity. Developmental regulator, not a cell-wall gene: the route to fibre is indirect, via grain size and shape changing the pericarp:endosperm ratio and hence fibre as a percentage of grain.

PEBP-family protein (PF01161). Route is phenological, not biochemical: flowering date sets the temperature and water regime during grain filling, and warm dry filling raises barley grain beta-glucan while cool wet filling lowers it. A credible pleiotropic hit in a wild panel spanning a climate cline. Note the Swiss-Prot name VERNALIZATION 3 only means nearest curated PEBP; true VRN3/HvFT1 is on 7H, not 4H.

Plasma-membrane-type Ca2+-transporting ATPase (ACA/P2B), 80.3% identity, full-length coverage. CslF/CslH synthesise (1,3;1,4)-beta-glucan in the Golgi and glycosyltransferases are divalent-cation dependent, so secretory-compartment ion homeostasis is a real but entirely generic mechanism. Nothing specific to beta-glucan.

Carboxylesterase, alpha/beta hydrolase fold (PF07859). The fold family does contain cell-wall esterases (cutinases, pectin acetylesterases, GDSL lipases). But the Swiss-Prot hit is a tulip-specific tuliposide-converting enzyme at 46% identity, i.e. effectively 'some esterase', and it sits in the same locus (fiber_L14) as the GH17 above, so LD hitch-hiking is the simpler explanation.
ZMYM1/FAM200 RNase-like domain (PF14291) - a domesticated transposase-derived domain. No functional route to fibre. Flagged because it ranks 2nd of 23 by q.
Retrovirus-related Pol polyprotein from transposon TNT 1-94; reverse transcriptase (PF07727). A retroelement, not a trait gene.
Pentatricopeptide repeat / DYW protein. Organellar RNA editing; no credible route to grain fibre.
Nematode resistance protein-like HSPRO1 (Hs1pro-1). Defence/immunity; no credible route to fibre.
C2 domain, SRC2/BAP type (PF00168), GO:0006952 defence response. Ca2+-dependent membrane binding in defence signalling; generic.
L-type lectin-domain receptor kinase IX.1. LecRKs do participate in cell-wall-integrity sensing, but the link is generic and the identification is 46.9% identity.

Kinesin-like protein KIN-7D, chloroplastic (PF00225). A solid identification (82.8% identity, full coverage) of a microtubule motor - a clean example of confident identification without biological candidacy. Only route to starch is via grain size, which is very indirect.
Calmodulin-binding receptor-like cytoplasmic kinase (CRLK1-like). Cold/Ca2+ signalling; cold does shift starch-sugar partitioning, but the route is long and unspecific.
SH3 domain-containing protein 2 (SH3P2-like). Clathrin-mediated endocytosis and autophagosome formation; autophagy touches starch turnover only distantly.
Late embryogenesis abundant protein, LEA_2/Lea14-like (PF03168, WHy domain). Abundant seed maturation/desiccation protein; no route to beta-glucan beyond general grain maturation timing.
RING-H2 finger E3 ubiquitin ligase, ATL family. Broad regulatory family; no specific beta-glucan connection.
SIL1/FES1 nucleotide-exchange factor for BiP, ER (GO:0005783). Secretory-pathway chaperone cofactor; generic housekeeping.
MA3 domain translation regulatory factor (PDCD4/eIF4G-related, PF02847). Translational regulation; generic.
No call from Swiss-Prot, InterPro or NCBI nr. Cannot be judged on function. Notable because it ranks 1st of 23 by q.
